name: manage_ledger
description:
Manage ledger books, accounts, categories and budgets.
A book holds its own accounts, categories and budgets, and every total is reported in the book's currency. New books start with a set of default categories. Budgets are monthly limits in the book's currency; spending in a sub-category counts towards its parent. Entries themselves are recorded with ledger. Display details such as account type, opening balance and category icons are set in the dashboard.

action.description: What to create, or list to see what exists.

what.description: For action=list: which of them to list. Books by default.

name.description: For create_book, create_account and create_category: the name.

currency.description: For create_book: the ISO code every total in the book is reported in. For create_account: only when the account holds another currency.

direction.description: For create_category: which tree it belongs to. Expense by default.

amount.description: For set_budget: the monthly limit in the book's currency.

category.description: For set_budget: limit this one category instead of the whole book.

book.description: Which book. Only needed when more than one exists.
